_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Kana ndugo {player_id} cikin Wasan Tic Tac Toe na Mutum Uku.
Alama nka ita ce '{symbol}'.
Kana dauka wuri na alama nka a kan allo na 5x5 domin kirkirar layi na hudu.
Layi na iya zama kwarai, tsaye, ko kwance.
Mika wuri nka da salon '[4]' domin kada kuri 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kala ndolo mana. Kisa '[cell]' kwa kala {max_cell} ɗawɗo.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Lambar kuri ba daidai ba: {cell}. Dole ne iya zama tsakanin 0 da {max_cell}.

game_action.placed: Ndugo {player_id} ya sa alama nsa ({symbol}) a filin ({row}, {col}).
